name: Code
category_description: Core node - built-in logic, data or generic API functionality
description: The Code node lets you run your own JavaScript or Python inside a workflow, so you can transform data or add logic the built-in nodes don't cover

common_issues.title: Code doesn't return items properly
common_issues.summary: This error occurs when the code in your Code node doesn't return data in the expected format

common_issues.title: A 'json' property isn't an object
common_issues.summary: This error occurs when the Code node returns data where the json key isn't pointing to an object

common_issues.title: Code doesn't return an object
common_issues.summary: This error may occur when your Code node doesn't return anything or if it returns an unexpected result

common_issues.title: 'import' and 'export' may only appear at the top level
common_issues.summary: This error occurs if you try to use import or export in the Code node. These aren't supported by n8n's JavaScript sandbox. Instead, use the require function to load modules

common_issues.title: Cannot find module '\<module>'
common_issues.summary: This error occurs if you try to use require in the Code node and n8n can't find the module

common_issues.title: Using global variables
common_issues.summary: Sometimes you may wish to set and retrieve simple global data related to a workflow across and within executions. For example, you may wish to include the date of the previous report when compiling a report with a list of project updates

common_issues.title: Can't access credentials in a code node
common_issues.summary: By design, Code nodes can't access credentials. They don't have access to n8n’s internal credential management system. This prevents exposure of sensitive authentication data
